result: For the explicit maximal 4-dimensional rank-at-least-3 subspace S below and its orthogonal projector P, EVERY 2-block-positive operator lambda I_16-P is decomposable (a sum of a PSD operator and a partial transpose of a PSD operator), and has expectation at least 3/1450 on every normalized 4x4 PPT state. This excludes this entire projector-witness family globally, including after arbitrary local filtering, not merely the previously studied 4x12 source. The argument does not exclude other 2-block-positive witnesses or resolve whether PPT/SN3 states exist.
rank3_subspace: Let D=diag(1,5,-9,3), U the 4x4 first superdiagonal shift, L=U^T, and S=span{I4,D,U,L}. A matrix aI+bD+cU+dL with c nonzero has the triangular 3x3 minor rows 0,1,2 and columns 1,2,3 equal to c^3. With c=0 and d nonzero, the transpose-oriented minor is d^3. With c=d=0, distinct diagonal entries of D imply a nonzero aI+bD has at most one zero diagonal, and thus rank at least 3. The four spanning matrices are pairwise Hilbert-Schmidt orthogonal, with squared norms 4,116,3,3; therefore P=[I4]/4+[D]/116+[U]/3+[L]/3, with [X] denoting the unnormalized vectorized rank-one projector. S is maximal in dimension by the standard determinantal bound (dimension (4-2)^2=4); this maximality is not required for the exclusion.
block_positivity_lower_bound: The Schmidt-rank-two ket q=|11>-2|22> has norm squared 5 and exact overlap <q|P|q>/<q|q>=279/290. Thus 2-block positivity of lambda I-P requires lambda>=279/290=24/25+3/1450; no calculation of the exact Schmidt-rank-two maximum is needed.
explicit_decomposition: Write W0=(24/25)I_16-P=A+B^Gamma, with Gamma Bob's partial transpose and A defined by this identity. B is 1/500 times a real symmetric matrix, in the tensor basis |i,j> at linear index 4i+j. Its singleton diagonal blocks on indices (0,1,4,10,11,14,15) are each [1]; its remaining direct-sum blocks are given by the next field. All omitted entries are zero. Exact rational Schur pivots establish A >= I_16/1000 and B >= I_16/10000. Consequently W0 is decomposable although it is neither required to be 2-block positive nor itself PSD; for every lambda>=279/290, lambda I-P=W0+(lambda-24/25)I is decomposable and its expectation on normalized PPT rho is at least lambda-24/25>=3/1450.
genuinely_mixed_decomposition: The unnormalized ket x=|13>+2|22>+|31> satisfies <x|W0^Gamma|x>=-3172/2175, so this decomposition cannot be simplified to the claim that W0 is coCP. Separately W0 itself has negative eigenvalue -1/25 on S, so the proof truly uses a sum of PSD and coPSD terms.

exact_check.observed: Fraction arithmetic checks P^2=P, builds the displayed rational blocks and A, verifies 16 strictly positive Schur pivots for each of A-I/1000 and B-I/10000, confirms overlap 279/290 and gap 3/1450, and evaluates the partial-transpose test as -3172/2175. The decomposition identity is entrywise by the defining formula for A. The determinant/rank2 arguments above are written reasoning, not formal proof.

relation_to_prior_packet: This global decomposition supersedes the narrower arbitrary-Bob-filter bound for the same P in frontier-20261028-hor-ces-spectral-barrier-v1.json. The earlier distinct projector example was shown coCP; here the exhibited pre-threshold W0 is not coCP, while decomposability still excludes the witness family.
limits: One specific maximal rank-3 subspace and one scalar-projector witness family; no claim for general subspaces, general positive maps, or all possible 4x4 PPT/SN3 witnesses. WRITTEN plus exact rational arithmetic replay; no novelty, external or formal review.
